notes.title: Screaming Chicken Christmas Playtest FAQ
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow chicken!

Thank you so much for your attention! We have sent game keys to the picked players' email address. Please pay attention to check it.

This test has officially started and will end on December 21st 7:59 AM (UTC-8:00). Merry Christmas~ GLHF


【BUG/Suggestion Feedback】Click https://wj.qq.com/s2/11408161/0697/, the current version is just a test version, there may be some bugs and issues, thank you for your feedback and understanding.


[FAQ about this test]


Q: What is the difference between this test version and the previous test version?
A: This test version adds Christmas skins and maps, mainly to accompany everyone to spend a happy Christmas holiday~

Q: Which modes can players experience in this testing?
A: The current test version offers local and online modes. The types of gameplay are chaos and 2V2. A single game supports 2-4 players. You can randomly match players from all over the world, or you can team up with friends. Also support handle to play the game!

Q: What should I do if I can’t match anyone?
A: Due to the limited scale of this test, if you can’t get match online, you are welcome to join our discord to find teammates.

Q: What should I do if I get network problems while online?
A: It is recommended that you use vpn to speed up the game before starting it. Pay attention to improving the local network conditions of the connection, and ensure that the host player has a good network condition; or choose to play locally;

Q: Can I choose the screen and resolution by myself?
A: Yes! You can choose by yourself in the settings, we recommend that you adjust the picture quality according to your device/network conditions to maintain a high and stable frame rate.

Q: Is it possible to live broadcast or publish test content on social media platforms?
A: Of course! You are very welcome to share your wonderful operations and funny moments on your social platforms in the form of videos/graphics and texts! We will be very grateful for your publicity. And we will pick some players to give the game key after the official release.

Q: Is there any fee to join this test?
A: No, please be wary of anyone who try to make you to pay.

Q: Will the game progress of this test be saved?
A: This test is a file deletion test, and the game progress will not keep your record when Screaming Chicken officially launched.

If you have any other questions, please contact us!

notes.title: Beta Test is avaliable now !
notes.content:
We received many applications from players after sending out the invitation for test recruiting, and we are very grateful for your support of the game. The current version of beta is detailed in the following paragraphs.ːsteamhappyː

Time：
UTC 2022.09.16 00:00 ~ 2022.09.18 23:59
How to participate Screaming Chicken Beta Test? 

Feedbacks：
As a beta version, the current game version does not represent the final quality of the game. During the test period, if you find any bugs or have any suggestions about the game, welcome to join our discord channel and post at [#bug-reports]! Emails are welcome too!


Event：
After participated the game test, finish our questionnaire and you can have a chance to win free keys! After the game's release, the key will be sent via email to five players who chose to fill out the survey.

QUESTIONNAIRE URL :
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdsZbT6PjIJhOlc5FTnfILRivgfPwklnFfh189OBQ1SCFm_7g/viewform?usp=sf_link （Copy link to browser to open）

FAQ：
Q: What are the differences between the current beta and the last test?
A: To begin with, we've improved the map / skin and other game art since the last beta (detailed explanation provided in the last R&D log), and we've also included a few new maps to this beta so that players can have a more varied and thorough experience with our game.

Q: What kind of game mode are players able to experience throughout this beta?
A: We currently have local and online options available in this beta. You can play local games with your friends or family or randomly match up with online players from across the world. Don't forget you can play this game with controllers too!

Q: How many players are required for one game?
A: FFA mode allows for 2-4 people per game, and 2V2 mode calls for 4 players per game.

Q: Do the players need to pay anything for this beta?
A: This test does not required any kind of fees and please be wary of anyone who tries to make you pay in this beta.

Q: Will the data be saved after the beta test?
A: No. Every data will be deleted at the end of this beta. The characters and game progress will not be saved in the next beta or in the final game version.

Q: As a streamer, can i stream this game?
A: Of course. We are more than welcome for streamers that are willing to stream our game. For Twitch streamers, you can link your Twitch account to this game and your viewers can send prop codes in the chat, help you gain more useful props and enjoy the game as much as you do.


For those players who can't participate in this beta, don't worry! We will have a new beta testing soon. Please follow our updates and join the next one!

Last but not least, we hope that you can enjoy the pleasure of many test maps and strive to become the king of the chicken!
